messages:
Elena Watanabe: Heads-up 30 found a month-end deferral mismatch for customer NEXA (INV-NEXA-301). They prepaid a 6-month Dedicated package on 2025-06-10 but the deferral schedule started 06/01. Looks like system used billing_period month boundary. Can someone confirm?

Ravi Singh: Can you paste invoice row? Was service_start set to 06/10?

Elena Watanabe: invoice_id: INV-NEXA-301, invoice_date: 2025-06-10, amount: 60,000, service_start: 2025-06-10, service_end: 2025-12-10, rule: Prepay-SixMo.

Marta Gomez: If service_start is 06/10 we should prorate June (partial month) and then 5 full months. If system used 06/01 then June was fully recognized and remaining months shifted.

BillingBot: Payment posted INV-NEXA-301 amount $60,000 processed 2025-06-10.

Ravi Singh: I'll pull the GL. If mis-recognized we need a reversing JE and corrected schedule. Also flag billing pipeline to prefer invoice.service_start when it differs from contract start by >5 days.

Jules Park: Agreed. I'll coordinate with eng-billing on a validation rule. For now create adjusting JE and note in month-end pack.

Elena Watanabe: Thanks team. I'll attach the contract and Sales note. Marking as month-end priority.
